title: Navigate from landing page to registration
description: Verifies an unauthenticated user can reach the registration page from the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the create-account call to action
Verify the registration page is displayed

title: Navigate from landing page to login
description: Verifies an unauthenticated user can reach the login page from the landing page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the sign-in call to action
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Authenticated user is redirected from landing page to dashboard
description: Verifies that an authenticated user visiting the landing page is redirected to the protected dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Register a new user successfully and reach dashboard
description: Verifies a user can create a new account with valid inputs and is redirected to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill Test User into the name field
Fill a unique valid email into the email field
Fill a valid password with at least 6 characters into the password field
Submit the registration form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Registration validation: short name is rejected
description: Verifies registration shows a validation error when the name is shorter than the minimum length.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill A into the name field
Fill a unique valid email into the email field
Fill a valid password with at least 6 characters into the password field
Submit the registration form
Verify a name validation error is visible

title: Registration validation: invalid email format is rejected
description: Verifies registration shows a validation error when the email format is invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill Valid Name into the name field
Fill invalid-email-format into the email field
Fill a valid password with at least 6 characters into the password field
Submit the registration form
Verify an email validation error is visible

title: Registration validation: short password is rejected
description: Verifies registration shows a validation error when the password is shorter than the minimum length.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill Valid Name into the name field
Fill a unique valid email into the email field
Fill a password shorter than 6 characters into the password field
Submit the registration form
Verify a password validation error is visible

title: Login successfully and reach dashboard
description: Verifies an existing user can sign in with valid credentials and is redirected to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Login validation: invalid email format is rejected
description: Verifies login shows a validation error when the email format is invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill invalid-email-format into the email field
Fill any valid-looking password into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify an email validation error is visible

title: Login validation: missing password is rejected
description: Verifies login shows a validation error when the password is missing.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill nothing into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify a password required validation error is visible

title: Protected dashboard loads for authenticated user and shows primary account and counts content
description: Verifies an authenticated user can access the dashboard and see identity plus aggregate counts.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the dashboard greeting shows the current user's name and email
Verify total user count and active session count are displayed

title: Unauthenticated access to dashboard redirects to login
description: Verifies the protected dashboard cannot be accessed when not signed in and redirects to login.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Dashboard access remains stable after refresh-like revisit
description: Verifies the authenticated user can revisit the dashboard route and still see the primary dashboard content.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the dashboard greeting shows the current user's name and email
Verify total user count and active session count are displayed

title: Logout ends session and redirects to login
description: Verifies a signed-in user can log out from the dashboard and is returned to login.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Trigger the logout action
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: After logout, dashboard is no longer accessible and redirects to login
description: Verifies logout prevents further access to the protected dashboard until re-authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /dashboard
Trigger the logout action
Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the user lands on the login page

title: Unauthenticated users cannot use logout flow because dashboard is blocked
description: Verifies users who are not authenticated are redirected to login when attempting to reach the dashboard entry point for logout.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard
Verify the user lands on the login page
